column1: # 6.956-957 tempestate coorta is an ablative absolute; remotae ... facessunt has its own plural subject.
# 6.1000-1001 ratio reddetur is future passive, the register's "give a reasoning"; omnis moves to 1001 with its noun.

column2: and, when a storm has risen in earth and sky,
they withdraw, far off, into sky and earth, as is right;
for the rest, from here the reasoning will be given with ease,
and the whole cause laid open, that lures the force of iron.
